summary: ICL Group Ltd. filed a 6-K to supplement a prior dividend report of May 13, 2026. The company announced a $69 million dividend, equal to $0.05350 per share (or ILS 0.1504955 for shekel recipients). The record date is June 2, 2026, and payment on June 17, 2026. Only shareholders entitled to at least US$2 will receive payment. Israeli withholding tax rates are described: nil for resident companies, 25% for resident individuals, and 25% or lower per treaty for foreign residents. This is a routine capital return—a cash dividend—with no special-situation event. The filing is a foreign private issuer’s supplemental report (6-K mapping to a U.S. Form 8-K Item 2.02-type update). What to watch: no risk-arb angle; it is a straightforward distribution.
